title: Anne Hathaway Cast Opposite Tom Cruise in Days of Thunder Sequel
description: Anne Hathaway will star opposite Tom Cruise in the sequel to Days of Thunder. The Oscar-winning star of The Odyssey and The End of Oak Street will play a team owner and engineer in the sequel, due out summer 2028.
